text: A thousand crunches, Russian twists, and ten-minute fat burners, every day. Belly fat, you're done!
Burning fat from one spot is one of the oldest myths.
For six weeks, one group did ab exercises. The other didn't.
Belly fat didn't change in either group. Their abs got stronger, but the fat stayed.
Abs are built with training, and revealed by a calorie deficit. Save this.
